note: Label Help has no settings page (configure=null). Its per-field help text is stored as a third-party setting on the field_config entity: third_party_settings.label_help.label_help_description (e.g. field.field.node.article.<field>). Code can also set a #label_help form element property. Medium cases seed that third-party setting on a real field and require the agent to read it back from live config; hard cases require setting the label help text on a given field, verified against the live field_config third-party setting (reset clears it so verify fails on empty). All grounded in real hooks/keys from label_help.module.

evals.prompt: Label Help has no admin settings page. How do I add help text under a specific field's label, and where is that text stored in configuration?
evals.expected_output: Edit the field and fill in the 'Label help message' textarea Label Help adds to the field settings form. It is stored as a third-party setting on the field_config entity: third_party_settings.label_help.label_help_description.

evals.prompt: In custom code (for a form that is not backed by a field config), which Form API property do I set on a form element to make Label Help render help text under its label?
evals.expected_output: Set the #label_help property on the form element, e.g. $form['email']['#label_help'] = t('...'); label_help_process_form checks it before falling back to the field's stored setting.

evals.prompt: Label Help puts its text in different places depending on the widget. Which setting can I enable to see which placement/use-case it chose for a field, and where is that setting configured?
evals.expected_output: Set $settings['label_help_debug'] = TRUE; in settings.php. It annotates each rendered help message with its widget use-case number and placement. There is also label_help_debug_dump to dump element arrays.

evals.prompt: On this site, one field on the Article content type has Label Help text configured. Inspect the live field configuration and report the field's machine name and the exact help text it shows below the label.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_lh_known and its label_help text is 'Known helper text for this field.' (stored in field.field.node.article.field_lh_known -> third_party_settings.label_help.label_help_description).

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has two fields, field_lh_on and field_lh_off. Exactly one of them has Label Help text configured. Inspect the live configuration and state which field has the label help text.
evals.expected_output: field_lh_on has the label help (its field_config carries third_party_settings.label_help.label_help_description), whereas field_lh_off does not.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a field field_lh_task with no label help. Using Label Help, configure it so the text 'Enter the internal reference code.' appears below that field's label on the edit form. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: field.field.node.article.field_lh_task now has third_party_settings.label_help.label_help_description set to a non-empty string (e.g. 'Enter the internal reference code.'), set via the field's 'Label help message' textarea or FieldConfig::setThirdPartySetting('label_help','label_help_description', ...).

evals.prompt: On my Articles there is a field called field_lh_task. I want my editors to see a little hint right under that field's label telling them to keep it short. Please make that hint show up.
evals.expected_output: The field_lh_task field on Article gets Label Help text (a non-empty third_party_settings.label_help.label_help_description on field.field.node.article.field_lh_task), so the hint renders under its label.
